label: CU loop • a named app is opened before the first step and worked in
notes: Deterministic (scripted-model) case for the `app` argument: the run opens the named app in the background before the model's first step, so the trace starts with `open` even though the model never asked for one, no takeover question is asked (`declineTakeover` is set, so asking one would end the run declined and fail the case), and the click lands in that app.
